headline: Midwestern State outscore every other programme in the division
dek: Two matches into the season, Midwestern State have scored eleven goals and conceded one. The 43 other programmes across the Great Lakes Valley, the Gulf South, the Great American and the Lone Star have all scored fewer, and no conference has yet opened its own play.
displaced_by: headline stands; dek corrected because the Great Lakes Valley joined the collect, so the rivals are 43 across four conferences, not 28 across three

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
